Date : Oct 08, 2021
Monetary Policy Statement, 2021-22 Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) October 6-8, 2021

On the basis of an assessment of the current and evolving macroeconomic situation, the MPC decided to keep the policy repo rate under the LAF unchanged at 4 per cent.

  • Keep the reverse repo rate unchanged at 3.35 per cent.

  • Continue with the accommodative stance.

Assessment

Global economic activity is recovering, though unevenly.
